Arnold Bennett, The Grand Babylon Hotel.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/arnold-bennett/the-grand-babylon-hotel

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Arnold Bennett, the author, died 1931.

First publication of the text used: 1901, serialised in The Golden Penny (United Kingdom), then the book, January 1902, Chatto & Windus (United Kingdom) (Wikipedia). SE colophon: 'The Grand Babylon Hotel was published in 1902 by Arnold Bennett.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1901, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States.
- Country of origin: copyright lasts for life plus 70 years after the death of the last person named above. The last to die did so in 1931, so the work entered the public domain there on 1 January 2002. The first publication (the 1901 serial) was in the United Kingdom.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
